example.title: Alexander and Anna Schwartz farm, barn

brief: Low gambrel-roofed barn with a single storey of red brick walls (patched and uneven, lighter mortar) and a gambrel loft roofed in rust-streaked corrugated metal that also sheathes the gambrel ends. Two pairs of gray plank doors on the long side, a small metal-clad loft door in the gable end. Stands out alone on the wheat plains behind a barbed-wire fence with an oil drum and cedars at the corner.
